show.description: Judwa Billionaire is an intense romantic drama of betrayal, sacrifice, and destiny. On her wedding day, Anjali discovers her groom’s shocking affair with her own sister Anaya, shattering her world. Forced into a marriage with the scarred and mysterious billionaire Jaydeep Raichand, she soon finds herself caught between his cruel tests, his charming twin Amandeep, and her own fight to save her mother—leading to a storm of love, lies, and survival.
